info.title: Angle API
info.description: With Angle API, you can easily track the state of the Angle Protocol or build an application on top of the protocol.

get.summary: Fetch data relative to the stEUR contract
get.description: This route fetches general stEUR contract data.

200.description: JSON object containing stEUR ERC4626 contract data.
Successful response

get.description: This route fetches historical savings data for specified chains, users, and agTokens.

parameters.name: agToken
parameters.description: The agToken to fetch data for (EURA or USDA)

parameters.name: chainIds
parameters.description: JSON array of chain IDs to fetch data for

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for historical data (omit for realtime data)

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Number of records to fetch

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for historical data

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User address to fetch data for

200.description: JSON array containing historical savings data for each specified chain

400.description: Error response for invalid or missing parameters

get.description: Generate a payload for depositing tokens into Angle protocol strategies.

parameters.name: inputTokenAddress
parameters.description: The address of the input token.

parameters.name: inputTokenAmount
parameters.description: The amount of the input token to deposit using token decimals. For example, 1 USDC would be 1000000 (6 decimals).

parameters.name: strategyAddress
parameters.description: The address of the strategy contract.

parameters.name: userAddress
parameters.description: The address of the user performing the transaction.

parameters.name: slippage
parameters.description: The maximum allowed slippage as a percentage value (i.e. 0.1 means 0.1%).

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the user.

200.description: The deposit payload information.

get.description: Generate a payload for withdrawing tokens from Angle protocol strategies.

parameters.name: outputTokenAddress
parameters.description: The address of the output token (the token that the user wants to receive after the withdraw from strategy).

parameters.name: inputTokenAmount
parameters.description: The amount of the input token to withdraw. This is the amount of the strategy token that the user wants to withdraw (with 18 decimals). For example, 1 stUSDStrat would be 1000000000000000000 (18 decimals).

parameters.name: strategyAddress
parameters.description: The address of the strategy contract.

parameters.name: userAddress
parameters.description: The address of the user performing the transaction.

parameters.name: slippage
parameters.description: The maximum allowed slippage as a percentage value (i.e. 0.1 means 0.1%).

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the user.

200.description: The withdraw payload information.

get.description: Retrieve overview data for a specific vault strategy.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: The chain ID (only Arbitrum is supported)

parameters.name: strategyAddress
parameters.description: The address of the strategy contract.

200.description: Successful response with vault overview data

get.description: Retrieve positions data for a specific vault strategy. Position are ordered by the most recent first.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: The chain ID (only Arbitrum is supported)

parameters.name: strategyAddress
parameters.description: The address of the strategy contract.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Number of items to retrieve

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip

200.description: Successful response with vault positions data

get.description: Retrieve position data for a specific user in a vault strategy.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID (optional, currently only Arbitrum is supported)

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Number of results to return (optional)

parameters.name: includeOperations
parameters.description: Whether to include operations (deposits, withdrawals) in the response (optional)

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of results to skip (optional)

parameters.name: strategyAddress
parameters.description: Address of the strategy (optional)

parameters.name: userAddress
parameters.description: Address of the user

200.description: Successful response with user's vault positions data

get.description: Retrieve historical position data for a specific vault strategy. Position are ordered by the most recent first.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: The chain ID (only Arbitrum is supported)

parameters.name: strategyAddress
parameters.description: The address of the strategy contract.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Number of items to retrieve

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of items to skip

200.description: Successful response with historical vault positions data

get.description: Retrieve historical operation data for a specific vault strategy.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: The chain ID (only Arbitrum is supported)

parameters.name: strategyAddress
parameters.description: The address of the strategy contract.

parameters.name: userAddresses
parameters.description: User address or array of user addresses

parameters.name: firstDeposits
parameters.description: Number of deposit items to retrieve

parameters.name: skipDeposits
parameters.description: Number of deposit items to skip

parameters.name: firstWithdrawals
parameters.description: Number of withdrawal items to retrieve

parameters.name: skipWithdrawals
parameters.description: Number of withdrawal items to skip

200.description: Successful response with historical vault operations data

get.summary: Get active chains for the protocol
get.description: Return the list of chains supported by the Borrow module.

200.description: OK

get.summary: Get TVL on a given chain
get.description: Return the TVL of the Angle Protocol on the requested chain. If no chainId is specified, will return the TVL accross all blockchains.

200.description: TVL on the requested chain

get.summary: Get EURA volume on a given chain
get.description: Return data related to the EURA volume on a given chain. If no chainId is specified, will return the volume accross all blockchains.

200.description: EURA volume and circulating supply data on the requested chain

get.description: Return data related to earning opportunities for a given user.

parameters.name: isTest
parameters.description: Optional flag to get Rinkeby data

200.description: Mapping between a staking contract address (used as a key) and its data (like description, APR, links, ...)

get.description: Return the allowances for a given user on a given chain for specific spenders. Can include additional token addresses.

200.description: OK

get.description: Retrieve data regarding a token used by a given user.

parameters.name: spender
parameters.description: Spender address

200.description: Successful response

get.summary: Get balances of Angle tokens for a user
get.description: Return the balances for tokens in the for Angle token list for a given user. Can include additional token addresses.

200.description: Mapping between a token address and for each token the user balance, the decimals of the token as well as the token name

get.summary: Fetch bridge data for a user
get.description: This route fetches bridge data for a user from multiple chains.

parameters.name: toChainId
parameters.description: destination of the bridge transaction

200.description: JSON object containing bridge data for the user on different chains.

get.description: Return the global state of `VaultManagers` listed by the treasuries associated to a stablecoin

200.description: List of all `VaultManager` with their details

get.description: Return all vaults for a user on a chain.

200.description: List of all the vaults for a given user on-chain

parameters.name: agTokenToBorrow
parameters.description: The amount of agTokens to borrow

parameters.name: agTokenToSwap
parameters.description: The amount of agTokens to swap for the collateral

parameters.name: amountsBrought
parameters.description: An array of objects representing the amounts and addresses of assets brought

decimals.description: The number of decimals for the asset

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: The ID of the Ethereum chain on which to perform the operation

parameters.name: collateralAddress
parameters.description: The address of the collateral contract

parameters.name: collateralToAdd
parameters.description: The amount of collateral to deposit

parameters.name: userAddress
parameters.description: The address of the user requesting the payload

parameters.name: vaultId
parameters.description: The vault to act on

parameters.name: vaultPermit
parameters.description: Vault permit

parameters.name: permits
parameters.description: Array of permits

parameters.name: slippage

parameters.name: oneInchSlippage

get.summary: Build payloads for Angle's borrow module
get.description: This route handles requests to build payloads for Angle's borrow module.

parameters.name: agTokenToRepay
parameters.description: The amount of agTokens to repay.

parameters.name: repayAll
parameters.description: If all the vault's debt is repaid.

parameters.name: amountsBrought
parameters.description: An array of objects representing the amounts and addresses of assets brought.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: The ID of the Ethereum chain on which to perform the operation.

parameters.name: collateralAddress
parameters.description: The address of the collateral contract.

parameters.name: collateralToWithdrawToWallet
parameters.description: The amount of collateral to withdraw.

parameters.name: collateralToSwap
parameters.description: The amount of collateral to swap to EURA.

parameters.name: userAddress
parameters.description: The address of the user requesting the payload.

parameters.name: vaultId
parameters.description: The vault to act on.

parameters.name: agTokenAddress
parameters.description: The address of the agToken.

parameters.name: outputTokenAddress
parameters.description: The address of the token wanted by the user.

200.description: JSON object containing the calldata bytes needed to build the Ethereum transaction.

get.description: Return data about tokens at stake in the Angle Protocol (price, icon, decimals etc)

200.description: Maps token addresses on the requested chain to their associated data and returns a list of pairs of tokens identified by their name with their price (in USD).

get.description: Return prices for tokens used by the Angle Protocol.

200.description: List of pairs of tokens identified by their name with their price (in USD).

parameters.name: to

parameters.name: data

200.description: Successful response

get.description: Execute multiple transactions in a single request and return the Tenderly url.
